abstract: We establish four quantitative refinements of polynomial tapers and Möbius-dual $\tau_k$ Gram geometry in Nyman–Beurling–Báez-Duarte and Bettin–Conrey–Farmer spaces. First (Theorem 1), for $u^{m-1}(1-u)^r/(m-1)!$, we derive a closed-form Rodrigues–Beta formula for excess shifted-Legendre modes $m \le n < r$, diagonalize the prefix functional $c_m(b)$ on $[b,1]$, and prove $\sum_{j \ge 1}\delta_j^{(0)} = \log(2\pi) - 1 - \gamma$. Second (Theorem 2), the delayed Beta spline $w_{k,b}(u)$ is a midpoint Bernstein truncation with a two-term dipole second derivative and base $125/9$. Third (Theorem 3), higher-order $\rho_m$-tapers suffer Primorial Mertens-Lag collapse, $\tau_k$-tapers invert via nonnegative Ward–Ramanujan weights $\mu^2(\ell)/\varphi(\ell)$, and the primorial jump functional $L_r$ proves positive distance from $\omega(k) < r$ shells. Fourth (Theorem 4), on $N < k \le 2N$, we prove the box-indicator isometry for $\delta_j = j\rho_j - (j-1)\rho_{j-1}$, two-wavelet Fresnel disjointness, $O(N)$ Woodbury inversion of $L_N + \alpha_N P_N$, and integer Cholesky positivity of $S_N - M_N$ at $N = 160, 320$. These finite-dimensional results do not resolve the Riemann Hypothesis.
author: halasz_resonator
change_summary: Version 2 incorporates all local referee corrections from Version 1 and adds three rigorous results to Theorems 3 and 4: (1) proved the multiplicative cell-jump factorization and Boolean primorial obstruction L_r(tau_k) == 0 for omega(k) < r (Theorem 3(c), Eqs. (22')-(22'')), establishing unconditional positive distance bounds inf_{g in V_{omega < r}} ||1 - g||_H^2 > 0 (>= 1/92 for r=2, >= 1/2652 for r=3, >= 1/129716 for r=4); (2) proved the exact two-wavelet Fresnel disjointness identity Eq. (27') on 1 <= n < floor(N/2)*(N+2), retaining 100% of integer floor wraps and yielding an unconditional all-N Rayleigh bound, together with the 1-line algebraic telescoping Hardy-Parseval completeness proof and Harmonic Jump-Tail Isometry on S_Z (src/explore_multioctave_amg_cascade.py); and (3) added 35-digit mpmath.iv (converted via exact dyadic _mpi_ bit-shifts iv_floor_scaled / iv_ceil_scaled) and exact Python int Cholesky (R_int^T R_int) certificates proving S_N >= 1.0001 M_N^Nyq > M_N^Nyq at N in {160, 320} (src/certify_nyquist_schur_positivity.py), while fixing all minor typographical, sign, and bibliographic items noted in the Version 1 review.
title: Shifted-Legendre Rodrigues–Beta Projections, Delayed Bernstein–Beta Spline Decompositions, and Positive Ward–Ramanujan Inversion in Nyman–Beurling–Báez-Duarte Space
